Fig 10. Sabbathichthys osbournei n. gen. et n. sp.
Lateral view of the holotype, MGP-PD 33551, in natural light (A) and coated in alcohol (B). Lateral view of the paratype, IGVR 64077, in natural light (C) and coated in alcohol (D). Interpretive reconstruction of the skeleton of the holotype (E). Scale bars 10 mm.
